event_v0.doc:
Emitted when a deposit is forwarded.

Native XLM deposits carry the XLM Stellar Asset Contract address in
`token`; consumers identify native deposits by comparing against the
network's XLM SAC address.
event_v0.name: Deposited

params.doc: The id correlating with an off-chain Layerswap order.
params.name: id

params.doc: The address that received the funds.
params.name: receiver

params.doc: The amount requested to transfer (fee-on-transfer tokens may\ndeliver less).
params.name: amount

function_v0.doc:
Forwards `amount` of `token` from `from` directly to `receiver` and
emits a `Deposited` event. Native XLM is deposited by passing the XLM
Stellar Asset Contract as `token`.

`from` must authorize this call and the nested `token.transfer`
(one signed auth tree). The token itself rejects negative amounts
and insufficient balances; no other validation is performed \xe2\x80\x94
receiver legitimacy is enforced off-chain by the Layerswap backend.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc:
Forwards `from`'s entire allowance granted to this contract to
`receiver` and emits a `Deposited` event. Companion to `deposit` for
flows where the amount was fixed in an earlier `token.approve(from,
depository, amount, live_until_ledger)` transaction.

`from` must authorize this call \xe2\x80\x94 the allowance alone must not let a
third party spend it with their own `id`/`receiver`. Do NOT use with
"infinite" approvals: transferring the full allowance fails on
insufficient balance. Use `deposit` instead.
function_v0.name: deposit_allowance
